description: Economic data RELEASE CALENDAR from FRED — the dates indicators are/were published, including FUTURE scheduled dates. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "when is the next CPI / jobs report / GDP release", "economic calendar", "Fed data release schedule". Omit release_id for the cross-release calendar; pass a release_id (from fred_releases — e.g. 10 = CPI, 50 = Employment Situation, 53 = GDP) for one release schedule. Returns release name + date, newest/upcoming first by default.

release_id.description: Optional FRED release id (from fred_releases). Omit for the all-releases calendar.

sort_order.description: asc or desc (default desc — newest/upcoming first)

name: fred_release_dates
title: Fred Release Dates
